jobs.title: Call for Applicants: Advisory Committee — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for "experts" to join an advisory committee — not a paid entry-level role, and it seeks established specialists (an expert advisory panel), which the candidate is not. Although the human-rights and securitisation subject is broadly on-mission, it fails as both a level and a genuine-paid-vacancy test.
